question: 查询区域region_guian4下各租户的ECS实例数量、云硬盘数量、云硬盘总容量和ECS规格分布
sql: SELECT tenant_domain.tenantName,COALESCE(tenant_base."ecs_count",0) AS "ecs_count",COALESCE(tenant_volumes.volume_count,0) AS volume_count,COALESCE(tenant_volumes.total_volume_size,0) AS total_volume_size,COALESCE(tenant_flavors.flavor_distribution,'[]') AS flavor_distribution,COALESCE(tenant_flavors.unresolved_flavor_vm_count,0) AS unresolved_flavor_vm_count FROM (SELECT tenantName FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA UNION SELECT tenantName FROM CLOUD_VOLUME) AS tenant_domain LEFT JOIN (SELECT tenantName, COUNT(*) AS ecs_count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA GROUP BY tenantName) AS tenant_base ON tenant_base.tenantName IS tenant_domain.tenantName LEFT JOIN (SELECT tenantName,COUNT(*) AS volume_count,SUM(CAST(size AS REAL)) AS total_volume_size FROM CLOUD_VOLUME GROUP BY tenantName) AS tenant_volumes ON tenant_volumes.tenantName IS tenant_domain.tenantName LEFT JOIN (SELECT tenantName,json_group_array(json_object('flavor_id',flavorId,'flavor_name',flavor_name,'vcpu',vcpuSize,'ram',ramSize,'disk',diskSize,'ecs_count',n,'resolved',resolved)) AS flavor_distribution,SUM(CASE WHEN resolved=0 THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS unresolved_flavor_vm_count FROM (SELECT v.tenantName,v.flavorId,f.name AS flavor_name,f.vcpuSize,f.ramSize,f.diskSize,COUNT(*) AS n,CASE WHEN f.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS resolved FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA AS v LEFT JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR AS f ON v.flavorId=f.id GROUP BY v.tenantName,v.flavorId,f.id,f.name,f.vcpuSize,f.ramSize,f.diskSize) AS tenant_specs GROUP BY tenantName) AS tenant_flavors ON tenant_flavors.tenantName IS tenant_domain.tenantName

sql.before_refine: SELECT tenantName, COUNT(*) AS ecs_count FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA GROUP BY tenantName
sql.model_proposal:
SELECT tenantName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id) AS ecs_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CLOUD_VOLUME.id) AS volume_count,
       SUM(CLOUD_VOLUME.diskSize) AS total_volume_size,
       CLOUD_FLAVOR.name AS flavor_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id) AS flavor_ecs_count
FROM CLOUD_VM_NOVA
LEFT JOIN R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.id = R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.vmId
LEFT JOIN CLOUD_VOLUME ON R_VOLUME_MOUNTON_VM.volumeId = CLOUD_VOLUME.id
LEFT JOIN CLOUD_FLAVOR ON CLOUD_VM_NOVA.flavorId = CLOUD_FLAVOR.id
GROUP BY tenantName, CLOUD_FLAVOR.name
ORDER BY tenantName, flavor_ecs_count DESC
